name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while squeezing your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row machine with feet on the platform.
Pull the handle towards your lower chest while keeping your back straight.
Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand at a cable machine with a straight bar attachment set high.
With arms slightly bent, pull the bar down to your thighs.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope attachment at upper chest height on a cable machine.
Pull the rope towards your face, separating the ends as you pull.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Machine Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the machine and grip the handles.
Pull the handles down toward your shoulders while squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Machine Seated Row
instructions: Sit at the machine and grip the handles.
Pull the handles towards your chest while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Machine Back Extension
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Push back against the pad extending your spine.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support.
Row the dumbbell up towards your hip while keeping your back flat.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back holding dumbbells.
Row both dumbbells up towards your hips.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Smith Machine Bent Over Row
instructions: Set the bar at mid shin height on the smith machine.
Hinge at the hips and row the bar to your lower chest.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips holding a barbell with overhand grip.
Row the bar to your lower chest keeping your back flat.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a pull up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Chin Up
instructions: Hang from a pull up bar with an underhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press the bar back up to starting position.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc motion.
Bring them back together at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc motion.
Bring them back together at the top.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set cables at shoulder height on both sides.
Stand in the middle and bring both handles together in front of your chest.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Low Cable Chest Fly

Stand in the middle and bring both handles up and together in front of your chest.
Slowly return to starting position.

Press the handles forward until your arms are extended.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Machine Incline Chest Press

Press the handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Pec Deck Machine

Bring the pads together in front of your chest.
Slowly return to starting position.

Lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press the bar back up to starting position.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press

Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up to starting position.

name: Push Up

Lower your chest to the floor.

name: Freemotion Abdominal
instructions: Sit in the Freemotion abdominal machine.
Crunch forward bringing your chest toward your knees.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Overhead Tricep Rope Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable machine and face away.
Extend both arms overhead until fully extended.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Rope Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable machine.
Push the rope down and flare the ends out at the bottom.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Hammer Strength Iso Lateral Row
instructions: Sit at the Hammer Strength iso lateral row machine.
Pull one handle at a time toward your hip.
Slowly return to starting position.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Attach a bar or rope to a low cable machine.
Curl the attachment up to shoulder height.
Slowly lower to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Slowly lower to starting position.
